$comment.description:
This document outlines the specifications for the RTR ISO 20022 System Event Notification (Heartbeat Notification) message. Prior to reading this RTR ISO 20022 Message Specification, it is highly recommended to read the RTR ISO 20022 Message Specification Companion Document that is published alongside it since the Companion provides high-level context and an overview of the message portfolio and content. 

RTR Usage:
This message will be sent by the RTR Exchange as an application heartbeat notification to RTR Participants. 

Scope:
The SystemEventNotification message is sent by a central system to notify the occurrence of an event in a central system.

Usage:
The message can be used by a central settlement system to inform its participants of an event that is going to occur in the system, for instance that the system will be down at a certain time, etc.
